attacker_pocs.name: https_rr_name_length
attacker_pocs.why: A local DoH server supplies an HTTPS RR with a truncated TargetName. The new name scan reads the next label length before checking that the offset is inside the copied RDATA buffer.

role_a_rationale: The decoder rejects type 65 RDATA shorter than the two-byte priority plus a TargetName byte, and unit cases cover lengths zero through two. The copied-record name scan is a plausible adjacent validation step but reads a next label length before validating its offset. A malformed label reaches that read through curl_easy_perform, producing an ASan heap-buffer-overflow on the patch; the pinned parent completes the same probe without an ASan report.
